change: fleet/dependabot.yml + dependabot.d/{gomod,swift,npm}.yml: retire the legacy Conventional token from the dependabot commit prefix — ":arrow_up: build(deps)" -> ":arrow_up:(deps) ". The trailing space suppresses dependabot's ": " separator (pr_name_prefixer.rb only appends it after [A-Za-z0-9)\]]); measured hosted on glyph-test #39, where title and commit both read back as lint rc=0. Closes the last machine producer of the retired token (t-271n); existing open dependabot PRs keep the old prefix until their next weekly or a recreate, and bots are lint-exempt so nothing turns red meanwhile.
